draft.emotion: earnest and focused, with a clear sense of purpose
notes: Irregular in the present (eu quero, ele quer) and preterite (eu quis, ele quis).
To make a polite request ('I would like'), use the imperfect 'Eu queria...' or 'Eu gostaria de...'.
With 'dizer', 'querer dizer' means 'to mean' (e.g., 'O que isso quer dizer?' — What does this mean?).

faults.quote: When used to mean 'to love', it is often applied to friends and family
faults.why: Confuses Portuguese with Spanish 'querer'; in Portuguese it requires 'bem' ('querer bem') and is marginal at A2.

faults.quote: To have feelings of affection or love for someone.
faults.why: Literary/fixed expression ('querer bem'); not an everyday standalone A2 sense in Brazil.
Includes 'to love', which misleads learners into using 'querer' like Spanish 'Te quiero'.
